text: “That was mean of you, but I suppose I deserved what I got.” “I should say you did deserve it,” Fred panted, “turning savage on me like that! I should say you did deserve it!” He saw her shoulders harden. “Well, I just said I deserved it, didn’t I? What more do you want?” “I want you to tell me why you flew at me like that! You weren’t playing; you looked as if you’d like to murder me.” She brushed back her hair impatiently.
